basis: The normal consumer registers ParentWriter, ParentInverse, then ParentFailures, after the existing system; World registration allocates system registry IDs in that order.

K.start initializes the failure runtime nextReader to 1; K.register keeps the system registry identity in Reader.registry, records nextReader separately as Reader.id, and increments nextReader after successful registration.
The consumer's FailureView serializes both RegistryView and readerId; Domain membership and event Position use the reader identity.
